title: What the night may settle without the owner
rule: Most restrictive match wins (owner_only > night_proposes > night_decides). A change that matches nothing is night_proposes. A night_decides entry matches only when its proof attributes are present and true; a missing proof is no match.

exam.note: night_decides takes effect only while the exam over the held-out items passes; below min_accuracy every night_decides answer degrades to night_proposes (src/rooms/policy/exam.ts).

split.design_items: design_items below: the decisions this file was written from. Their ids start with d.
split.exam_items: policy/exam.json: decisions this file was NOT written from. Their ids start with x. A test fails when an id sits on both sides or when an entry example cites an exam item.
split.time_cut: Rule-proposal decisions up to 2026-10-14 are design (the five owner revocations of 2026-10-01/03); decisions from 2026-10-15 on are exam. Memory files: see design_items; every other memory file is exam.

change_descriptor.note: What a caller hands to classifyChange. Every field is optional except that a descriptor with no kind, files, settings or tables is unknown (night_proposes).
change_descriptor.kind: string, what the change is, e.g. lp_fault_repair, docs_regenerate, rule_adopt, setting_change, data_delete
change_descriptor.files: string[], repository-relative paths the change touches
change_descriptor.settings: string[], setting keys the change writes
change_descriptor.tables: string[], database tables the change writes
change_descriptor.attrs: object of string|number|boolean proofs, e.g. bench_subset_passed, auto_revertible, always_on, irreversible

matcher.note: A matcher is an AND of the fields it carries; an entry matches when ANY of its matchers matches. Globs: * stays inside a path segment, ** crosses segments, ? is one character; matching is case-insensitive and paths are normalised (./ and .. are resolved, a path that leaves the repository starts with ../).
fields: files_any (some touched file matches some glob)
files_all (every touched file matches some glob; needs at least one file)

night_decides.description: Repair of a failure class that is Lane Pilot's own fault, accepted only with the bench subset passing and a one-step revert ready.
examples: close the class 'wildcard folder patterns own their contents' with a regression test
stop the relay retrying archived PM chats

night_decides.description: Regeneration of generated documentation pages; only when every touched file is a docs file.
examples: nightly docs pass rewrites docs/*.md and packages/*/docs/*.md

night_decides.description: A memory note (not the core) reaches its end of life and is retired.
examples: note past its expires_at is archived

night_decides.description: Retire a harness tree that lost against the incumbent on the bench.
examples: trial arm B lost by the alternation rule and is retired

night_decides.description: A writer or PM rule goes into force on trial (not always-on); the owner can revoke it and the trial retires it by itself.
examples: adoptRuleProposal puts a model-written rule on trial

night_decides.description: Deploy or release of a change whose full suite and post-deploy drill are green and that rolls back by itself.
examples: bb-plugin-push of a green tree, then gh release

night_proposes.description: A rule that skips the relevance pick and rides in every prompt.
Default model, provider, reasoning effort, service tier or agent for a role.
examples: writer default moves to another model
a role picker is reset to global

night_proposes.description: A stage is added to, removed from or reordered in the pipeline.
examples: add a code critic stage before acceptance

night_proposes.description: Any edit of the work graph: workflow definitions and the workflow engine.
Change of the project's core memory (rules and conventions every agent reads).
examples: trim the core instead of failing

owner_only.description: Money, quotas and budgets: caps on attempts, tokens, wall time, children, daily judge calls, memory budgets.
Writing, moving or re-fencing secrets and the Env Catalog access model. Using a key as an agent is not a change and is not classified here.
Anything on data that cannot be undone: deletes, drops, history rewrites, emptying trash.
examples: DELETE FROM a core table without a backup

owner_only.description: The judge: acceptance and integration gates, drills, the canary and the full-suite gate, the code that decides done or not done.
The fixed bench set the night is measured against.
examples: swap a task in the bench subset

owner_only.description: Verification thresholds: accuracy bars, acceptance scores, exam threshold.
This policy, its exam, its classifier and its tests.
Owner login, caller checks and confirmation forms: the owner rejected them (2026-10-08); only the owner brings one back.
A change outside this repository cannot be benched or reverted by the night.
